hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully handles swap execution using its own curve invariant (CurveLib): it takes input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager. Standard CLAMM liquidity addition and donations are blocked via revert.
